proposed_comments.title: Preserve resource-map entries during package transfer
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve resource-map entries during package transfer

**Severity:** `high`

The transfer copies advertised formats but omits `DataPackageView.GetResourceMapAsync()`. HTML payloads that reference packaged images or other URI resources therefore retain their markup while silently losing the referenced content.

Please copy the source resource map into `destination.ResourceMap` before the payload becomes available. The shelf drag can await this work under `DragStartingEventArgs.GetDeferral()`; the non-deferrable list drag path should prepare or coordinate the map without converting `DragItemsStarting` into an untracked `async void` handler or silently rejecting an otherwise valid immediate drag. Add focused coverage for an HTML/resource-map package.

confidence.rationale: The changed classifier already handles CommandKind.Directory and DataPackageHelper accepts StorageFolder, but the new filter permits only file-oriented kinds and File.Exists.

proposed_comments.title: Include directory bookmarks in filesystem drags
proposed_comments.body:
### Include directory bookmarks in filesystem drags

**Severity:** `medium`

The new package filter excludes `CommandKind.Directory` and only calls `File.Exists`, even though the helper already supports folders. As a result, file bookmarks can be dragged to Explorer or other filesystem targets while directory bookmarks expose no equivalent package.

```suggestion
        var localFilePath =
            classification.Kind is CommandKind.FileExecutable or CommandKind.FileDocument or CommandKind.Shortcut or CommandKind.InternetShortcut or CommandKind.Directory &&
            (File.Exists(classification.Target) || Directory.Exists(classification.Target))
                ? classification.Target
                : null;
```

confidence.rationale: The only new consumer is the Bookmarks assembly, and the Indexer project already uses InternalsVisibleTo for narrow cross-assembly access.

proposed_comments.title: Keep the Indexer drag helper internal
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the Indexer drag helper internal

**Severity:** `medium`

Changing `DataPackageHelper` from `internal` to `public` expands the Indexer extension's externally visible API solely to share implementation code with the Bookmarks assembly. That creates compatibility expectations for a helper that is not designed as a supported extension API.

Please keep the helper internal and grant `Microsoft.CmdPal.Ext.Bookmarks` friend access through `InternalsVisibleTo`, or move the helper into an intentionally shared internal assembly.

review_fixes.summary: Preserve extension-requested drag operations so external targets cannot unexpectedly move files.
Reserve dedicated capacity and columns for pin/remove targets so the final shelf item remains droppable.
Recalculate pin-target availability after capacity changes and preserve directory bookmark drag packages.
Transfer data-package resource maps asynchronously and hold the quick-access shelf drag deferral until preparation completes.
Prefetch list-item resource maps and keep the non-deferrable list drag path synchronous and lifecycle-safe.
Keep DataPackageHelper internal and expose it only to the Bookmarks assembly through InternalsVisibleTo.
